opening.argument: The video is a straightforward Wells Fargo tutorial for setting up Zelle, with the speaker explaining how to register an account to send and receive payments and how to select a linked account and register an email or mobile number. The on-screen settings and code-entry screens correspond to those setup steps, while text-message enrollment is presented as verification. These are instructional account-configuration actions, not requests to send money or provide credentials to the creator. The separate Cash App description offers a stated $5 incentive and discloses an affiliate-style referral, but it is not connected to the Zelle walkthrough. The available evidence describes no deceptive behavior or user loss, and contact access is expressly presented as optional.
